pack_unpack_any_message: pack a protobuf message into an Any type and unpack it back to the original message
convert_timestamp_to_json: convert a Timestamp protobuf message to and from RFC 3339 JSON string format
convert_duration_to_timedelta: convert a Duration protobuf message to a Python timedelta and back to Duration
use_struct_as_mapping: use a Struct protobuf message as a mutable mapping to store nested key-value pairs
use_listvalue_as_sequence: use a ListValue protobuf message as a mutable sequence to append and access typed values
